items.title: House set to pass sweeping Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham
items.description: The Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill is on a path to become law after the House votes in favor.

items.title: Why you should worry about Anthropic, OpenAI's proposed AI risk evaluators
items.description: Anthropic and OpenAI are proposing embedded AI evaluators to help manage risk of models causing catastrophic harm to society, but the idea has some issues.

items.title: Senate is still a tossup, but Democrats now have slight edge, prediction market traders think
items.description: Traders on both Kalshi and Polymarket see Democrats with one of their best chances to flip the U.S. Senate since the contracts on the election opened.

items.title: Oil prices fall after U.S. says damaged Saudi pipeline will restart operations in days
items.description: The pipeline has allowed the Saudis to shift oil exports to the Red Sea while the U.S. and Iran battle for control over Hormuz.

items.title: OpenAI investors have approached the company about a new funding round
items.description: OpenAI is gearing up for what is widely expected to be a blockbuster IPO next year, after it confidentially filed its prospectus in June.

items.title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
items.description: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

items.title: World's top-performing sovereign wealth fund warns of looming pullback in U.S. stock market
items.description: New Zealand's $54 billion pension fund returned 14.2% in the year to June.

items.title: Costco expands Uber Eats delivery partnership to 47 states
items.description: Uber and Costco announced an expansion of a partnership where Costco members can order delivery from the store on Uber Eats to 47 states, up from 17.

items.title: Reddit co-founder says tech industry has been 'tone deaf' in explaining AI: 'Misinformation flying around'
items.description: Alexis Ohanian said AI risks are more mundane than the "Terminator and Skynet" scenarios some fear.

items.title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
items.description: The deal could be a big win for Intel which has been looking to gain marquee customers for its manufacturing, or foundry, business.

items.title: J.B. Hunt stock plunges 10% after company warns third-quarter earnings will fall
items.description: Shares of J.B. Hunt plunged more than 10% Wednesday after the company warned of an earnings drop between 5% and 10%.

items.title: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is getting a makeover as it prepares for its 'next 3,000' locations
items.description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe unveiled new branding as it grows rapidly under the ownership of private equity firm Blackstone.

items.title: Bizarre volatility bet in the options pits is a head scratcher ahead of Fed rate decision
items.description: The biggest trade in options on the Cboe VIX Index Tuesday was an unusual $6 million purchase of deep, deep in-the-money-puts.

items.title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
items.description: The Organization of Islamic Cooperation condemned the strike as a "heinous" attack. Mecca is Islam's holiest site and the focal point of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.

items.title: Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household
items.description: Rising oil prices and Treasury yields are lifting energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households, pushing consumers to draw more heavily on savings.

items.title: Mortgage demand from homebuyers drops 19% from a year ago, as interest rates surge abruptly higher
items.description: Mortgage rates have surged to the highest level since the start of 2025, causing a major pullback in mortgage demand.

items.title: Living abroad doesn't end your U.S. tax obligations. What young expats need to know
items.description: Americans living overseas may still face U.S. tax-filing and foreign-account reporting rules — even when they ultimately owe no U.S. income tax.

items.title: Flyers are happier with U.S. airports, despite near record travel levels, J.D. Power report shows
items.description: Travelers gave higher ratings in part because of the newer gates and terminals many airports have opened in recent years, according to the study.

items.title: Ukraine's message to Asian nations: your chips are turning up in Russian missiles
items.description: Ukraine's sanctions envoy said Russia could be forced to retreat from the war within six months if its oil revenues are halved.

items.title: China's AI leaders keep quiet despite U.S. 'publicity' on tech risks
items.description: Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, Alibaba and Tencent did not provide any statements when contacted by CNBC about the warnings on AI from Silicon Valley.
